senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced.) guard, trnsf. (v. גֶּדֶר) preventive measure.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 5a:21">M. Kat. 5ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 21a:12">Yeb. 21ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 18:30">Lev. XVIII, 30</cite>) <he>עשו מ׳ למִשְׁמַרְתִּי</he> make a guard to my guard, enact measures to prevent a transgression of Biblical laws.
